descriptionChirho: Adjective meaning tame or docile, used of a lamb led to slaughter (Jer 11:19 'a docile lamb').

Noun meaning close friend, intimate companion, or confidant; used of a trusted friend (Ps 55:14, Mic 7:5, Prov 16:28, 17:9), a woman's husband (Prov 2:17), YHWH as husband of Judah (Jer 3:4), and leaders/companions set over someone (Jer 13:21).
Noun equivalent to eleph, meaning cattle or oxen (Ps 144:14 'our cattle are heavy-laden').
